5 June 2007

## Circular to Management Companies of SFC-authorised Real Estate Investment Trusts ('REITs')

## Electronic Dissemination of Public Announcements of SFC-authorised REITs

1. The SFC notes that the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong ('SEHK') will abolish the Main Board  requirement  for  paid  announcements  and  launch  the  new  regime  for  electronic dissemination  of  regulatory  information  (referred  to  collectively  as  the  'Electronic Disclosure  Project')  with  effect  on  25  June  2007.    The  SFC  hereby  clarifies  the implementation of the electronic dissemination regime among SFC-authorised REITs.

## Background

2. SFC-authorised  REITs  are  required  to  make  timely  disclosure  of  information  to  their unitholders by way of announcements.  Note to Rule 10.2 of the Code on REITs provides guidance on the manner of publication of announcements.
3. In  light  of  the  market  demand  for  more  timely  information  disclosure,  the  SEHK  has embarked  on  the  Electronic  Disclosure  Project  and  amassed  market  support  for  its proposals. According  to  the  SEHK,  the  Electronic  Disclosure  Project  is  to  be implemented in phases, with a transitional period of six months commencing on 25 June 2007, during which time all Main Board issuers are required to publish notifications in the newspapers instead of the need to publish full announcements.  One year after the commencement of the transitional period, all issuers shall have their own websites and publish their Listing Rules documents thereon for free access by investors.
4. Upon the implementation of the Electronic Disclosure Project, Main Board issuers are under  a  mandatory  requirement  to  submit  Listing  Rules  documents  to  the  SEHK electronically through the SEHK's Electronic Submission System.

## Dissemination of Public Announcements of SFC-authorised REITs

5. Since SFC-authorised REITs are listed on the SEHK, the SFC has adopted the policy of requiring SFC-authorised REITs  to implement the same method  of information dissemination that is practised among other Main Board issuers.

5 June 2007 Circular to Management Companies of SFC-authorised Real Estate Investment Trusts Electronic Dissemination of Public Announcements of SFC-authorised REITs page 2 of 2

6. Note to Rule 10.2 of the Code on REITs provides that ' electronic means of publication may  also  be  considered  by  the  Commission '.    In  light  of  the  new  disclosure  regime among other Main Board issuers, and the enhanced timeliness of information dissemination  to  be  achieved  as  a  result,  the  SFC  now  informs  managers  of  SFCauthorised  REITs  that,  beginning  25  June  2007,  insofar  as  they  adopt  such  disclosure dissemination  practice  as  that  set  out  in  the  revised  Listing  Rules  in  relation  to  the Electronic  Disclosure  Project,  their  electronic  publication  of  announcements  shall  be regarded as being in compliance with the Code on REITs requirement in respect of the manner of publication.
7. In line with the SEHK proposal, all REITs managers are required to publish notifications in  the  newspapers  during  the  transitional  period.        Further,  the  issuance  of  press announcements will be optional.
8. REIT managers should and are reminded to consider whether amendments to the trust deeds  of  the  REITs  are  necessary  before  implementation  of  the  new  disclosure dissemination regime, and if so, make such amendments in accordance with the terms of the relevant trust deeds.
9. For  the  sake  of  clarity,  REIT  managers  are  reminded  that,  prior  to  submission  to  the Electronic  Publication  System,  all  announcements  and  notifications  will  remain  to  be subject to approval by the SFC, unless otherwise informed by it.
